title: Agents extension item
description: A row on the Agents window's Extensions page (`.agents-window-extension-row`): extension icon, name and publisher (with a warning icon for contributions the Agents window doesn't support and badges such as Tools), description, and the switch that runs it in the Agents window. Disabled rows are dimmed.
usage: Rows of a kind="extensions" <vsc-customization-list>. Groups: AI Features, Supported (enabled by default), Other Extensions (disabled by default).

attributes.name: icon-src
attributes.description: Extension icon URL; otherwise the default extension codicon.

attributes.name: enabled
attributes.description: Runs in the Agents window (switch on). Disabled rows are dimmed.

attributes.name: warning
attributes.description: Unsupported contributions, e.g. "views, debuggers": shows the warning icon.

states.name: enabled
states.trigger: Click the switch; fires `toggle`. Disabled rows are dimmed.

examples.title: Extensions
